ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Saturn

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between family and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between money and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your image and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your career and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up home and family.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between routine and conversations. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1816175649000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between romance and money. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.
